chunks: Eating while in a state of janabah leads to poverty.

key_terms.الْأَكْلَ: eating; the act being discussed in the narration
key_terms.الْجَنَابَةِ: janabah; a state of major ritual impurity requiring ghusl
key_terms.الْفَقْرَ: poverty; the worldly consequence mentioned in the hadith
key_terms.رُوِيَ: it is narrated; indicates a reported transmission without mentioning a full sanad
key_terms.يُورِثُ: causes or brings about; indicates resulting consequence

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about eating while in a state of janabah?
ai.summary: This hadith states that eating while in a state of janabah is a cause of poverty. It conveys an ethical and ritual warning that connects neglect of taharah with harmful worldly consequences.
